title: Cosmic Eschatology
description: How does a universe end? Its fate is written in what fills it: matter decelerates the expansion, dark energy accelerates it, and the equation of state w decides whether it freezes, rips or collapses. The first study of Finality.

puzzle.goal: Whether the expansion of a universe speeds up or slows down depends on what fills it. Take the acceleration of the scale factor, d²a/dt², divided by the scale factor itself: ordinary matter and radiation of density ρ and pressure p pull it back, a vacuum energy Λ pushes it on. Write that relative acceleration.
puzzle.name: Second Friedmann (acceleration) equation
puzzle.ask: In density parameters the deceleration parameter is q = Ω_m/2 − Ω_Λ (q < 0 means acceleration). With Ω_m = Ω and Ω_Λ = Λ given, find −q: how strongly our universe accelerates towards its end.
puzzle.method: Differentiate the first Friedmann equation in time and use energy conservation dρ/dt = −3H(ρ + p/c²).
